v1.text: This is Meetra Field. You ask a question, and it makes a finished explainer video. Let me show you, live.

v2.text: I'll ask why the Dead Sea is so salty. In Direction, I tell it: mostly maps and data charts, and at most one video shot. Then I pick a look.

v3.text: A Gemini director writes the story beat by beat, and sends each beat to the engine that can show it truthfully. It followed my direction: charts, real maps, and just one generated video shot.

v4.text: Before anything renders, a fact-check agent checks every claim against Google Search. Fourteen claims, all supported, with the sources listed.

v5.text: Any beat can be changed in plain words. I ask the director to make this one simpler, and only that beat is redrawn.

v6.text: Then I render. The beats render in parallel on Cloud Run, narrated, with music and subtitles.

v7.text: Every finished video checks itself. Gemini reviews each beat, ffmpeg checks the picture and sound, and a flagged beat can be fixed in one click.

v8.text: The facts are checked again with the final numbers on screen. Here it caught one claim about Lake Lisan, with the evidence and a correction ready to apply.

v10.text: Exact where it matters, and checked before you see it. Built on Gemini, Nano Banana, Google's video model and Cloud Run.
